card.name: Pronunciation spellings in dictionary entries
card.fires_on: Marks inside or just before phonetic transcriptions in dictionary-style text, such as IPA slashes, pronunciation colons, stress marks, and respelled syllables. Also coordinate symbols like E before a slash.

modes.label: Before pronunciation
modes.description: Colon or slash that introduces a pronunciation or IPA respelling.

modes.label: Inside phonetic text
modes.description: A stress mark or phonetic letter within a pronunciation guide.

card.writes: It promotes zero-width spaces, comment openers and dollar signs, and suppresses code-like dollar sequences, so it adds little clear meaning.
